read.en: Micron rose 2.5% on Oct 23 to $877.55, trading between $858.34 and $891.89. It is below the falling 5-day ($889.7), 10-day ($911.5), 30-day ($996.0) and 100-day ($972.8) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($732.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($969.16), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 美光 10月23日上涨 2.5%，收于 $877.55，盘中区间 $858.34–891.89。股价位于下行的 5 日（$889.7）、10 日（$911.5）、30 日（$996.0）和 100 日均线（$972.8）下方，高于上行的 200 日均线（$732.1）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$969.16），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The close reclaimed $858 (Oct 15 low), and the $891.9 high stalled at the $881.5–890 resistance. Resistance is $881.5–891.9 (Oct 20–21 lows, 5-day, Oct 23 high), then $903–911.5 (Sep 14 low, 10-day) and $969 (SAR). Support is $849–858, then $804 (Jul 17 low) and $732–738 (200-day, Jul 29 low). A close above $892 would target $905–911; a close below $849 would open $804.

s.en: Oct 15 low $858; Jun 9 low $854.4; Oct 22 low $849.3
